parameters.content:
DATA CENTER COLOCATION RACK POWER OVERAGE BILLING APPROVAL
Value: turns a raw DCIM power-threshold alert into a manager-approved, correctly-tiered overage charge with a full audit trail.

WHO IT'S FOR: colocation operations and billing teams who currently calculate power overage charges by hand and chase down manager sign-off over email or Slack.

HOW IT WORKS:
1. Webhook receives a rack power threshold alert from the DCIM monitoring system.
2. Normalize + Fetch Contract pull the customer's contracted kW allocation.
3. Compute Overage Amount & Billing Tier (Code) applies a grace band and a 3-tier $/kW rate — real math, not a prompt.
4. Branch 1 exits draws within the grace band with no charge.
5. For billable overages, AI drafts a factual invoice-adjustment explanation.
6. A Gmail send-and-wait pauses the workflow for ops manager approval (Approve / Edit / Reject) — nothing bills without a human.
7. Branch 2 (3-way) commits the charge, applies a manager override amount, or waives it entirely.
8. Every outcome merges into one audit log across a Data Table, a Sheets ledger, and a Telegram alert to finance.

NODE SUMMARY: Rack Power Threshold Alert (webhook) -> Normalize Alert Payload -> Fetch Customer Contract Power Allocation -> Compute Overage Amount & Billing Tier (Code) -> Check Overage Threshold (branch) -> Draft Overage Invoice Adjustment (AI) / Log Grace Period Pass -> Request Ops Manager Approval (send-and-wait) -> Branch on Approval (branch, 3-way) -> Commit Overage Charge / Apply Manager Override Amount / Log Waiver Granted -> Notify Customer No Charge -> Merge Billing Outcomes -> Shape Billing Record -> Log Billing Decision -> Update Sheets Billing Ledger -> Notify Finance.

INPUT: a DCIM power-threshold alert webhook. OUTPUT: a committed billing charge (or waiver), a customer email where relevant, and a billing-decision log in a Data Table, Sheet, and Telegram alert.

STICKY COLOUR LEGEND: trigger=1 (yellow), transform=2 (grey/teal), ai=3 (purple/blue), branch=4 (orange), storage=5 (green), notify=6 (red/pink).

REQUIRED CREDENTIALS:
- Google Sheets OAuth2 -> Fetch Customer Contract Power Allocation, Update Sheets Billing Ledger
- OpenAI API -> Overage Drafting Model
- Gmail OAuth2 (swapnilailabs@gmail.com) -> Request Ops Manager Approval, Notify Customer No Charge
- Telegram API -> Notify Finance
- HTTP header auth for your billing system -> Commit Overage Charge

SETUP STEPS:
1. Point your DCIM/power-monitoring system's threshold-alert webhook at this workflow's URL.
2. Create/verify the Colocation Contract Ledger Sheet with a Power Allocations tab (customerId, allocatedKw) and an Overage Billing Log tab.
3. Attach the Sheets credential to both Sheets nodes.
4. Attach OpenAI credential to the Overage Drafting Model sub-node.
5. Set the ops manager's real email on Request Ops Manager Approval and confirm the approval form fields (Decision, overrideAmount).
6. Set real billing API URL/auth on Commit Overage Charge.
7. Set the finance Telegram chat ID on Notify Finance.
8. Adjust the grace band (default 5%) and tier rates (180/300/450 $/kW) in Compute Overage Amount & Billing Tier.

CONFIG VALUES TO CHANGE: grace band %, tier rates, billing API URL/auth, ops manager email, Telegram chat ID.

TEST: send a test webhook with measuredKw well above a sample allocation, approve the request when it lands in your inbox, and confirm Commit Overage Charge fires and the ledger updates.

ESTIMATED SETUP TIME: 30-35 minutes.

1. SWAP NOTIFICATION CHANNEL: replace Notify Finance's Telegram node with a Gmail digest for finance teams that prefer email.
2. ADD AN APPROVAL BRANCH: add a second sendAndWait to Request Ops Manager Approval's edited path so a director co-signs overrides above a dollar threshold.
3. CHANGE THE SCORING MODEL: adjust the grace band and tier boundaries/rates in Compute Overage Amount & Billing Tier to match your actual tariff schedule.
4. ADD A SECOND DATA SINK: append committed charges to your accounting system via an additional HTTP Request node after Commit Overage Charge.
5. ADAPT TO AN ADJACENT VERTICAL: retarget this exact approval-gated billing skeleton to cloud egress overage billing, shared-office metered utility overages, or manufacturing machine-time overage billing.

ERROR HANDLING: every external action node (Sheets read/write, Gmail send/wait, Data Table insert, billing API call, Telegram send) uses onError=continueRegularOutput with 3 retries at 2s intervals, so one failed call never blocks the rest of the audit log from being written.

API COST & RATE LIMITS: 1 OpenAI call per billable overage alert (grace-band passes make none); Gmail send-and-wait consumes no extra API calls but pauses workflow execution until the manager responds or the wait times out.

DATA PRIVACY: customer ID, rack ID, and power/billing figures are sent to OpenAI for the invoice-adjustment draft — no customer contact or payment details. Only billing metadata is stored in the Data Table and Sheet.

LIMITATIONS: the send-and-wait step depends on the ops manager's email client supporting the response form; a manager who never responds will leave the run waiting until n8n's wait node timeout is reached. Grace band and tier rates are placeholders and must match your actual customer tariff.

PREREQUISITES: a DCIM system able to fire a webhook, an OpenAI API key, Gmail/Sheets/Telegram credentials, and Data Tables created in your n8n project.

CREATOR CREDIT: Swapnil AI Labs - swapnil.mandloi7@gmail.com - swapnilailabs.netlify.app

**Rack Power Threshold Alert**
Webhook fired by the DCIM power-monitoring system when a rack crosses its alert threshold.
Path: /dcim-power-alert.
Entry point — carries customerId, rackId, and measuredKw.

**Normalize Alert Payload**
Flattens the DCIM alert into stable fields: customerId, rackId, measuredKw, measuredAt.
Protects downstream nodes from DCIM payload format changes.
Keeps the rest of the workflow vendor-agnostic.

**Fetch Customer Contract Power Allocation**
Looks up the customer's contracted kW allocation from the Colocation Contract Ledger Sheet.
Match key: customerId.
Retry 3x/2s, continues on error.

nodes.name: Note - Compute Overage Amount & Billing Tier

parameters.content:
**Compute Overage Amount & Billing Tier**
Code node computes overageKw, a 5% grace band, and a 3-tier $/kW rate (180/300/450).
Outputs: withinGrace, tierRate, overageAmount.
The real billing math lives here, not in a prompt.

**Check Overage Threshold**
Branch point 1: separates draws inside the 5% grace band from billable overages.
Condition: withinGrace == true.
Most minor fluctuations should exit here with no charge.

**Log Grace Period Pass**
Records a no-charge outcome for draws within the grace band.
Fields: billingOutcome = within_grace_no_charge, finalAmount = 0.
Feeds the same audit Merge as billable outcomes.

**Draft Overage Invoice Adjustment**
AI Agent drafts a factual overage line-item explanation using only the computed numbers.
Never invents a rate or kW figure.
Feeds directly into the human approval gate.

**Overage Drafting Model**
OpenAI chat model (gpt-4o-mini, temp 0.2) powering the invoice adjustment draft.
Low temperature keeps the explanation factual.
Swap here to change tone/cost.

**Request Ops Manager Approval**
Gmail send-and-wait: pauses the workflow until the ops manager responds Approve / Edit / Reject.
Control-flow floor — nothing bills without a human decision.
Override amount field lets the manager adjust the charge.

**Branch on Approval**
Branch point 2: 3-way switch on the manager's Decision field.
Outputs: approved, edited, rejected.
Each path leads to a genuinely different billing outcome.

**Apply Manager Override Amount**
Code node substitutes the manager's override amount for the AI-drafted overage amount.
Falls back to the original overageAmount if no valid override was entered.
Only reached on the edited branch.

**Log Waiver Granted**
Writes a waiver record when the manager rejects the charge.
Data Table: colo_overage_waivers.
Customer is not billed for this cycle's overage.

**Notify Customer No Charge**
Emails the customer that no overage charge applies after manager review.
Only reached on the rejected branch.
Retry 3x/2s, continues on error.

**Commit Overage Charge**
POSTs the final approved (or overridden) charge to the billing API.
Endpoint: /v1/charges.
Retry 3x/2s, continues on error — fed by both the approved and edited branches.

**Merge Billing Outcomes**
Recombines the committed-charge, no-charge, and grace-period branches into one audit stream.
3 inputs, combine-all mode.
Every alert reaches the log regardless of outcome.

**Shape Billing Record**
Single source of truth for the logged decision: customerId, rackId, billingOutcome, finalAmount.
Downstream nodes read via $('Shape Billing Record').item.json.*.
Never read $json directly after this point.

**Log Billing Decision**
Writes the final billing decision to the colo_billing_decisions Data Table.
Columns: customerId, rackId, billingOutcome, finalAmount.
Retry 3x/2s, continues on error.

**Update Sheets Billing Ledger**
Appends the same decision to the human-readable Overage Billing Log tab.
Gives finance a spreadsheet view alongside the Data Table.
Retry 3x/2s, continues on error.

**Notify Finance**
Posts the final billing outcome and amount to the finance Telegram channel.
Final step in the approval-to-billing pipeline.
Gives finance real-time visibility without opening the ledger.
